title: Lindsay Clancy will be retried in March for the killing of her 3 children
summary: Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother whose highly divisive murder trial shone a global spotlight on postpartum mental health, will be tried again on murder charges for the killings of her three…

image.caption: Lindsay Clancy appears in Plymouth Superior Court in Plymouth, Mass., on Nov. 2. (Greg Derr/Pool/Reuters)

blocks.text: Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother whose highly divisive murder trial shone a global spotlight on postpartum mental health, will be tried again on murder charges for the killings of her three children.
Her previous trial ended in mistrial in September
WARNING: This article contains details about violence against children.

Clancy, who previous trial ended in mistrial in September after the 12-member jury failed to reach a unanimous verdict, did not appear to show emotion in Plymouth Superior Court in Plymouth, Mass., Monday during the pivotal hearing in her case.
A date for the new trial was set for March 29, 2027.
